pk.context: 0.75 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: white to off-white, film-coated, round, biconvex tablet

tell: An endothelin type A receptor antagonist with over 1800-fold selectivity; its boxed warning covers embryo-fetal toxicity.

clues.text: A high-fat meal makes no clinically significant difference, and it is over 99% bound to plasma protein. Metabolism is split about equally between CYP3A and glucuronidation.
Formulated as a hydrochloride salt; the active moiety has a molecular weight of 510.6.
Approved under an NDA in one 0.75 mg tablet strength, supplied as bottles of 30 tablets.
Boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity; contraindicated in pregnancy and in hypersensitivity to the drug. Peripheral edema and anemia are the most common adverse reactions.
Reducing proteinuria in adults with primary IgA nephropathy at risk of rapid disease progression.
Blocks the endothelin type A receptor with more than 1800-fold selectivity over the type B receptor.
The generic name begins with A and has ten letters.
